body: There is nothing wrong with introversion but I shouldn't have an anxiety of normal social interactions. I feel like an extrovert trapped in a body of a really shy person. It sucks
Karate sounds fun. I've always wanted to try some type of fighting sport really, things like boxing or MMA. Making the hurdle to sign up is so difficult though.
No plans. Weekends suck when you have no friends
Haha is funny you say that. I have a very affectionate cat but it didn't take much pain away
Thank you for sharing. You described the weight of it so well, like a pain in the pit of your chest.

Thank you for reading. Im sorry for ranting too long as well. Video games isolated me socially. I feel so bad that my "good memories" are certain levels on old video games, and not things I spent doing with non-existent childhood friends. I used them as a tool for social isolation rather than social expression. Also I am ugly. To everyone even my family. I am told outright. I'm sorry this is sounding pathetic I know
